## 报道摘要 | Report summary

**中文。** 澳大利亚国家海事博物馆、昆士兰 DETSI 与海军联合团队以声呐搜索和潜水记录定位一处由团队认定为 Spitfire 的沉船。材料涉及澳大利亚十九世纪造船及船只后来的民用经历。

**English.** A joint ANMM, Queensland DETSI and naval team used sonar searches and diver documentation to locate a wreck identified by the team as Spitfire. It concerns nineteenth-century Australian shipbuilding and the vessel’s later civilian career.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 团队探测与鉴定日期为 2026-08-21，联合公告为 2026-11-19；并非公告当日发现。专业发言者包括 James Hunter 与 Celeste Jordan。本轮未检得完整调查报告。

**English.** Detection and team identification took place on 2026-08-21; the joint release is dated 2026-11-19, not the discovery day. Specialist speakers include James Hunter and Celeste Jordan. A full survey report was not located.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 这次公布的是定位与初步记录，不是完整发掘。船体测绘、排他性鉴定指标及建造和改装阶段仍需详细发表；不提供遗址精确位置。

**English.** The announcement concerns location and initial recording, not complete excavation. Structural plans, diagnostic identification criteria and construction or alteration phases need detailed publication. Precise site coordinates are not supplied.
